change: A repeated Sound call for the active note reuses the existing HDMI DMA stream only when HDMI is selected, the stream is marked running, and the DMA controller reports active without error. A different note, stop, analog output selection, inactive DMA or DMA error follows the existing restart/stop path.

evidence.result: pass under address and undefined-behavior sanitizers for the tone-reuse decision and its stopped, switched-output, changed-note, inactive-DMA and DMA-error cases

scope: Host decision tests and cross-build only. No physical Pi test, audible timing measurement, DMA fault injection on hardware, or microSD staging was performed.
